observations.note: The same file was read in three or two consecutive calls, likely range reads, which a single read with a larger range could have covered.
Many guess-style searches and globs outside the hand-off's reading list, several returning nothing, suggest the hand-off did not say where the review check and eval cases live.

conformance.item: Rules to follow: open plan.rule.md and documents.rule.md with the read tool
Procedure 1: read triage note, hand-off, then the specs they name
Procedure 1: open other files only for what the hand-off list does not answer, and say so in section 0
Procedure 2: stop early on a defective spec
Procedure 3: read the code by path and find verification commands in tempergraph.commands.json
Procedure 4: requirements cover every acceptance criterion
Procedure 6: measure complexity against the plan rule
Procedure 7: complex plan has phases, goals, weights and commands only, no rows
Procedure 8: list documents the change makes false under Docs to update
Procedure 9: write the plan to docs/plans/i203a.plan.md with status planned
Limits: no shell, write only the plan, no git, stay in the working directory
Limits: do not claim the plan is correct
What to end with: ARTIFACT plan and ARTIFACT complexity lines
If you are blocked: BLOCKED or UPSTREAM lines
